You will use work orders, drawings, sketches, fabrication standards, and programs to produce parts on the CNC machines for Crusoe Fabricators. This role is crucial to our manufacturing process, ensuring the efficient and accurate production of high-quality components.   * **Soft Skills and Work Ethic:** Must be detail-oriented, a team player willing to take on additional roles, and have a good attitude and willingness to learn.
